Quitting Parley during a meeting no longer loses the meeting.

**Quit saves the meeting first** (#720)

- Pressing ⌘Q, choosing Quit from the app menu, or Quit from the Windows tray during a meeting now ends the meeting and waits for it to be saved before Parley closes. While it saves, Parley shows "Ending and saving the meeting — Parley will quit once it is saved."
- The saved recording keeps its transcript and playback. Its summary, action items and score are generated the next time you open it.
- A meeting cut off this way, or recovered after a crash, keeps its name with the mark （已復原）, e.g. "Weekly sync（已復原）". Automatic naming no longer renames it.
